title: Aerospace companies seek patent rights over UFO technology

tellings.quote: authorizes them to get patent rights that's what they want they want to get patent rights uh to technology so that the United States government for the next thousand years

plain: Aerospace companies want patent rights over technology from unknown craft, says a lawyer named Dan Sheehan, so that they, not the public, control it "for the next thousand years". He says this on Jesse Michels's show in 2024, without naming a source, while talking about a 2023 law that was being weakened. If true, it would mean private firms are fighting to own whatever the government has recovered.
